name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Fix: the plugin's own assembly version had been left at 0.0.90.0 in the project file for the last two releases (0.0.91, 0.0.92) - only meta.json's version was being bumped, not the .csproj's Version/AssemblyVersion/FileVersion. Jellyfin identifies an installed plugin's version from the loaded assembly itself, not the folder it was extracted into, so the server kept seeing '0.0.90.0' installed no matter which zip it had actually unpacked - permanently mismatched against whatever the repository manifest advertised, which is what made 0.0.92 (and technically 0.0.91) refuse to reconcile as installed. The assembly now correctly reports 0.0.93. 256 tests, all green.
